Companion Animal Travel Desk - Documentation and Assistance Policy

The purpose of this section is to define how the Companion Animal Travel Desk supports travelers who bring pets on Aurelia Skyways services.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk handles documentation and coordination so each journey remains smooth, respectful, and predictable. Travelers are expected to submit required materials before movement across skyports so the senior coordinator can make consistent daily service decisions. This service treats each trip as shared responsibility, with you preparing your pet for travel and the desk ensuring that every needed step is understood, tracked, and completed.

To start, the desk must verify the required boarding form. The "boarding" form FM-597 is the form required for the process in plain words. Staff will review the information for completeness, confirm that the pet details are readable and accurate, and ensure any instructions are aligned with journey handling procedures. If you are working through the desk with Jonah Meyer and Zain Ali, the desk will likewise confirm that their companion animal, Sadie, is correctly identified in the submission package, then confirm any relevant travel constraints without imposing unnecessary steps.

After review, the desk provides clear guidance on timing and handoff at check-in so there is no confusion on arrival areas. The desk also clarifies what the traveler should bring, how to label companion animal carriers, and what to expect during boarding preparation under Aurelia Skyways procedures. When operational conditions affect movement, the desk communicates the impact promptly and keeps your pet’s needs in view, while maintaining safe, consistent standards for staff and other passengers.

If documentation is missing or unclear, the desk will pause processing only to the extent needed to correct the record, then resume once the matter is resolved. This approach protects your travel plans and reduces stress for both travelers and companion animals.

For assistance with form submission, carrier requirements, and desk coordination, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
